name: Average Bear 68
author: boryanakrasteva
description: Outlined rounded white form that glows and scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes scale(1.1), background-color changes from transparent to #ffffff, box-shadow becomes 2px 2px 10px #7c7c7c. On focus, the outline is removed, background-color changes from transparent to #adadad, box-shadow becomes 1px 1px 10px #ffffff.
html:
<form class="form">
    <label class="label">username</label>
    <input class="input" type="text">
    <label class="label">password</label>
    <input class="input" type="text">
    <button>Submit</button>
</form>
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Average Bear 68</title>
<style>
/* Average Bear 68 by boryanakrasteva — https://uiverse.io/boryanakrasteva/average-bear-68 */
.form {
  width: 250px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 20px 40px;
  background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.034);
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.192);
  transition: .2s linear;
}

.form button {
  align-self: flex-end;
}

.form:hover {
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

.label {
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-bottom: -10.6px;
}

.input {
  height: 25px;
  width: 100%;
  border: 0.5px solid white;
  background-color: transparent;
  color: white;
  padding: 5px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  transition: .2s linear;
  position: relative;
}

.input:focus {
  outline: none;
  background-color: rgba(173, 173, 173, 0.233);
  box-shadow: 1px 1px 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.137);
}

button {
  border: none;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  transition: .2s linear;
}

button:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.74);
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 10px rgba(124, 124, 124, 0.192);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<form class="form">
    <label class="label">username</label>
    <input class="input" type="text">
    <label class="label">password</label>
    <input class="input" type="text">
    <button>Submit</button>
</form>

</body>
</html>
